# Fuime

> Fuime is a financial platform for teen-run businesses. It gives a founder aged 13–17 a place to take payments, track every transaction, keep receipts against those transactions, and understand what they owe at tax time — with a parent or guardian as the legal account owner and signer.

Fuime is a financial technology company, not a bank. Payment accounts are opened and owned by a parent or guardian through Stripe, which holds and settles the funds. Fuime never takes custody of anyone's money.

## How it works

- **The guardian is the legal party.** Every venture's payment account is a Stripe connected account owned by the teen's parent or guardian, who signs the terms, is the Stripe representative, and is responsible for fees and chargebacks. The teen operates the business day to day; the guardian approves payouts.
- **Money never flows through Fuime.** Customers pay the venture's own connected account directly. Fuime's cut is taken as a Stripe application fee on that charge, so funds settle to the family's own bank account rather than to a Fuime-controlled pool.
- **Every transaction lands in a ledger.** Balances, pending charges, receipts, and comments work the way they do in any real bookkeeping system — Fuime inherits a ledger engine that has been in production use since 2018.
- **Tax tracking.** Fuime flags when a venture crosses the $400 IRS self-employment filing threshold, so a first-time founder is not surprised in April.
- **A path out.** Books export cleanly when the founder turns 18 and forms their own LLC.

## Who it is for

- Teen founders aged 13–17 running a real business — resale, services, software, crafts, events — who cannot open a business account or sign a contract on their own.
- The parents and guardians of those founders, who want visibility into what their child is earning and spending, and a defensible legal structure around it.

Under-13 signups are refused. Stripe's own floor for a connected-account representative is 13 even with a guardian involved.

## Pricing

- **Free** — one venture, with Fuime keeping a percentage of what that venture collects.
- **Family plan** — a flat monthly fee for unlimited ventures at a lower percentage. Billed to the parent or guardian.

## What Fuime is not

- Not a bank, and not a provider of checking accounts, savings accounts, or deposits. Nothing on the platform is FDIC insured.
- Not a fiscal sponsor, and not a 501(c)(3). Fuime does not confer tax-exempt status and does not accept tax-deductible donations.
- Not a lender, and not a card issuer to minors by default.

## Attribution

Fuime is a fork of HCB by Hack Club (https://github.com/hackclub/hcb), released under the AGPL-3.0. Fuime is an independent product and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by Hack Club or The Hack Foundation. HCB is a fiscal sponsorship platform for nonprofits; Fuime serves for-profit teen businesses and has a different legal and financial architecture.
